 EXPLANATORY NOTE

On March 23, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing successful clinical trial results for its enhanced EpiCapture™ Prostate Cancer test. A copy of the press releases is filed herewith as Exhibit 99.1.

The Company has also obtained a limited waiver in respect of covenant 8.15 of its Credit Agreement with Perceptive Credit Holdings III. Interest accruing in March 2026 will be capitalised and added to the principal balance of the debt.
